column1: # Known debt of the object checks (harness/lib/objclash.py, harness/README.md "Build paths and
# clashing copies"): only findings not listed here fail `build-and-verify.sh --all`; a row that no
# longer occurs is a WARN, so the list only shrinks. Format: kind <TAB> unit <TAB> symbol.
#   path: the unit's object has a function that uses a build-path __FILE__ string. The one row is
#         tDatabaseInfo::StreamIn, a partial match whose inlined tBuffer::Get still carries it.
#   copy: a claimed function two or more units define with different code or relocation targets
#         (inline expansion or a stand-in name differs from unit to unit); the unit column is "-".
#   unclaimed: a function the unit's object defines out of line under a decorated symbol that the
#         symbol table places at an address in the exe, while no // FUNCTION: claim in that unit
#         covers the address. Each row is a body that carries the original's symbol and is not held
#         to its bytes: claim it as a real attempt, or remove it, then delete the row.
